invariants.name: door_mirrors_switch
invariants.statement: the Door is present if and only if the Switch shows 7

invariants.name: right_room_locked (a0p-no-switch only)
invariants.statement: with no Switch the Door never opens, so the Cart never occupies a right-room cell

rules.name: push
rules.then: the Cart moves one cell in direction D
rules.when: act=D and the target cell is floor or the open Door

rules.name: toggle
rules.then: the Switch flips 7<->8 and the Door mirrors it (present iff 7); the Cart does not move.  Works from all four directions, both ways.
rules.when: act=D and the target cell is the Switch

rules.name: teleport
rules.when: act=D and the target cell is the Portal marker

rules.name: blocked
rules.when: act=D and the target is a wall, the Crate, or the closed Door
